channel: protocol-fellowship/_threads/is there a spec for snap sync strategy,
searchText: Snap sync is not part of protocol spec but depends only on client implementation. Closest to spec for geth would be this https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/blob/master/caps/snap.md
